entities.name: Esper
entities.description: One of the five shards of Alara, where all creatures are infused with the magical alloy etherium and mages and sphinxes rule.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane that was once a single plane and later split into shards.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: A magical alloy that infuses all creatures on Esper and is used to refine and perfect flesh.

entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: A group of Esper mages devoted to infusing all life on the plane with etherium, a mission they call the Noble Work.

entities.name: Noble Work
entities.description: The Ethersworn mission to eliminate the imperfect chaos of life through etherium.

entities.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
aliases: the sphinx who rules the whole place
entities.description: A sphinx who rules Esper and envisions using etherium to make the whole plane ascend to a new level of consciousness.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara full of knights and castles, divided into five nations that respect a caste system.

entities.name: Jhess
entities.description: A coastal nation of Bant, currently at war with Valeron.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: A coastal nation of Bant, currently at war with Jhess.

entities.name: Akrasa
entities.description: A nation of Bant on the central savannah.

entities.name: Eos
entities.description: A nation of Bant on the central savannah.

entities.name: Topa
entities.description: A nation of Bant on the central savannah.

events.summary: Bant's culture descends from a military tradition from when Alara was one plane; after the shards split apart its armies became ceremonial and its martial arts ritualized.
events.quote: Over the years, Bant's armies became less martial and more ceremonial.

events.summary: Jhess and Valeron are at war, though battle on Bant is more ritual than brutal.
events.quote: Jhess and Valeron, for instance, are currently at war
